## Candidate-search tools (`candidate_tools.py`, `candidate_image.py`, `candidate_checklist.py`)

A serious candidate image shows four simultaneous properties: banded height
(no downward trend), calibrated mean letter with nontrivial non-coboundary
shadow bias (D_3, D_9, D_27, D_5, D_11, D_13 — order-2/parity is exempt),
near-full factor diversity at the critical scale p = floor(log2 Y), and **no
mixed-tower max-plus descent certificate**: margin
inf_{lambda>=0}(P_H(lambda) - lambda*eps) >= 0 at all tested levels 2^a 3^b,
persisting under lifts.

```sh
# four-panel image + JSON diagnostics + six-step checklist for one candidate
python3 search/candidate_image.py --seed 687871 --steps 55 --out viz/cand_687871.png
python3 search/candidate_image.py --pilot 0 --out viz/cand_pilot000.png

# six-step checklist over a batch (120 pilots + champions + harvested
# ascending windows) + the (D,eps)->margin overlay on the phase diagram
python3 search/candidate_checklist.py     # writes viz/fig8_candidate_margins.png
```

The six checks: (1) C1 drift (mean b > log2(3)+eta = descent-forcing);
(2) repetition at critical p (collision distance < 2^{p+1} = rigidity
fires); (3) complexity ratio >= 0.9 (else low-complexity ghost); (4) a
non-coboundary character detects the bias; (5) Karp certificate margin at
levels 2^a 3^b (negative = descent certificate); (6) margin persists under
2- and 3-lifts (else finite artifact). Only windows surviving all six
deserve attention — and the two known ways to then kill them are OUTSIDE
the six: the ghost/realizability test (pilot words: full-bit-length least
representatives) and window transience (real ascending windows belong to
orbits that crash after the window).
EOF
cd /home/john/mynotes && git add shadow_frontier/search/candidate_tools.py shadow_frontier/search/candidate_image.py shadow_frontier/search/candidate_checklist.py shadow_frontier/search/README.md shadow_frontier/viz/cand_687871.png shadow_frontier/viz/cand_pilot000.png shadow_frontier/viz/fig8_candidate_margins.png && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Candidate-search tool suite: four-panel candidate images, six-step
checklist, mixed-tower certificate margins, (D,eps)->margin overlay

New tools per the four-property candidate spec:
- search/candidate_tools.py: diagnostics library - band stats (H, D,
  trend), shadow biases D_3/D_9/D_27/D_5/D_11/D_13 (chi(2)-order >= 3,
  parity exempt), complexity profile P(p)/(M-p+1) with critical scale
  p = floor(log2 Y), min repeated-block collision distance (vs 2^{p+1},
  rigidity trigger), and Karp max-plus certificate margin
  inf_lambda(P_H(lambda) - lambda*eps) over levels 2^a 3^b (vectorized
  Karp + golden-section on the convex lambda-problem; -inf = acyclic
  trap). Six-step checklist: C1 drift / repetition / complexity /
  shadow / certificate / lift.
- search/candidate_image.py: four-panel render (height band, phase map
  with shadow-bias inset vs 1/sqrt(M) null, complexity panel with
  critical scale marked, mixed-tower margin bars) + JSON diagnostics +
  checklist verdict. Works on integer seeds, pilot words (seed-1
  stream), or explicit words.
- search/candidate_checklist.py: batch runner (120 pilots + champions
  + 60 harvested net-ascending windows) + fig8 overlay: candidate
  windows on the phase diagram colored by certificate margin.

First batch results (N=185): 111 die by certificate (60%), 1 by
complexity (champ 27 also collides); champions 4591/31911/517191 die
with large negative margins (-4.5/-7.3/-11.6); 687871 dies at level
2^8 3^4 (margin -1.42, green at lower levels - lift check catches it).
Six-check SURVIVORS = pilot ghosts (killed by realizability, outside
the six - annotated) + transient ascending windows of convergent
orbits. The demo images: cand_687871.png (textbook trap: all green
until the 2^8 3^4 lift), cand_pilot000.png (textbook ghost: perfect
four-panel candidate living at height 2^385).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
